title: Caves running under the Giza plateau

tellings.quote: doing that, they hit a cavern and uh you go through like one of these cracks in the walls and there's these caves that go under the Giza Plateau, the whole plateau.

tellings.difference: Drum says caves and tunnels are known for certain to exist. He does not give Luke's account of reaching them through a cavern and cracks in the walls.
tellings.link_reason: Both make the same general place-lore claim that caves run beneath the Giza Plateau.

plain: Caves are said to run beneath the whole Giza plateau, the ground the great pyramids of Egypt stand on. A researcher named Luke Caverns tells Michels that people working there broke into a cavern, and that if you pass through one of the cracks in its walls you reach caves that go under the entire plateau. Another researcher, Jeffrey Drum, says on a later episode that it is known for certain that there are caves and tunnels below Giza, though he says nothing of the cavern or the cracks. Neither man names a source. If they are right, the pyramids sit on top of a hidden underground world.
